disqualifier.note: Named install-timers options object. uninstall true skips installTimers entirely, so refresh true is accepted and ignored rather than rejected. refresh absent, false, and true are all supported with either uninstall value.

evidence.note: runWorktreeRemove copies archive and deleteBranch into WorktreeRemovalRequest at Worktree.command.ts:888-897. validateRemovalRequest rejects deleteBranch without archive, so that pair is not a supported removal.

notes: Raw CLI options object distinct from WorktreeRemovalRequest. deleteBranch implies archive; the other three pairs proceed into removal.
